settings.name_in_paper: Dynamic pricing with adversarial inventory constraint (censored linear demand)
unmapped: Price p_t in [0, p_max]; potential demand d_t = a - b p_t + N_t linear with unknown a, b
Observed demand censored by inventory: D_t = min(gamma_t, d_t); reward p_t * D_t
Inventory levels gamma_t chosen adversarially (pre-committed) and revealed at start of each round
Noise i.i.d., zero mean, supported on [-c, c], unknown distribution with L_F-Lipschitz CDF
Learner knows bounds a_max, b_min, b_max, gamma_min, c, p_max
settings.definition_quote: For $t=1,2,...,T:$ The seller (we) receives $\gamma_t$ identical products. The seller proposes a price $p_t\geq0$. The customers generate an invisible potential demand $d_t\geq 0$, dependent on $p_t$. The market reveals an inventory-censored demand $D_t=\min\{\gamma_t, d_t\}$. The seller gets a reward $r_t = p_t\cdot D_t$. All unsold products perish before $t+1$.

conditions: linear demand d_t = a - b p + N_t with 0<a<=a_max, b_min<=b<=b_max (Assumptions 1-2)
noise i.i.d., zero mean, supported in [-c,c], CDF L_F-Lipschitz (Assumption 3)
inequalities of Assumption 4: a-c > gamma_t > 2c, a - b p_max - c > 0, gamma_min > a_max - b_min p_max + c, p_max >= a/(2b)
T larger than any polynomial of the problem constants (Assumption 5)
tuning: confidence constants C_a, C_b, C_N, C_tau set with eta = (C_a + C_b p_max)/(10 c T^{5/4})

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Let $\tau={\sqrt{T}}$ in \Cref{algo:C20CB}. For any adversarial $\{\gamma_t\}_{t=1}^T$ input sequence, C20CB suffers at most $\tilde{O}\left(\sqrt{T}\cdot\log\frac{T}{\delta}\right)$ regret, with probability $\Pr\geq 1-\delta$.

results.notes: Regret defined via expected revenue functions r_t (pseudo-regret style) against per-round optimal price p_t^*, holding with prob >= 1-delta. Feedback mapped to partial_monitoring per guidance on censored observations. Constants depend on problem parameters hidden in O_tilde.
